artDirection.name: NeoSaniye editorial science collage
artDirection.prompt: Editorial historical-documentary collage designed for motion graphics. Tactile paper texture, restrained halftone print shading, clean readable silhouettes, layered depth, limited palette of warm ochre, muted cyan, off-white, charcoal and deep navy. Historically plausible, sophisticated rather than childish, no interface design.
artDirection.negativePrompt: text, captions, labels, logo, watermark, signature, UI, infographic layout, modern cars, modern street furniture, plastic 3D render, glossy advertising, childish cartoon, duplicated objects, malformed anatomy, cropped subject, busy unreadable composition

assets.prompt: A vertical wide-angle street scene outside the Houses of Parliament in London in 1868. Horse-drawn carriages crowd and cross the road in opposing directions, pedestrians in Victorian clothing wait at the pavement, Westminster architecture is clearly recognizable in the distance. Separate visual depth into foreground carriage silhouettes, middle-ground traffic and background buildings. Leave breathable negative space in the upper-middle area. No traffic light visible. No text.

Full isolated view of the 1868 London gas-powered road traffic signal inspired by railway semaphore technology: tall cast-iron post, two clearly separated mechanical semaphore arms mounted on pivots, central gas lantern housing with red and green lens mechanism, Victorian engineering details. Front three-quarter view, entire object visible with generous empty margin, clean readable silhouette, no street, no people, no lettering, designed as a separable animation cutout.

Full-body Victorian London police officer from 1868 standing in a practical operating pose, one hand extended to pull a mechanical lever, period-correct dark uniform and helmet, serious alert expression. Entire figure visible from helmet to boots, clean silhouette, isolated, no scenery, no text, designed as a layered editorial collage cutout.

Side view of a complete 1860s London horse-drawn carriage moving toward the left, horse and carriage fully visible, historically plausible harness and wheels, strong readable silhouette, isolated with generous margin, no driver text, no scenery, editorial halftone collage cutout.

Side view of a complete 1860s London horse-drawn carriage moving toward the right, different carriage design from the other vehicle, horse and carriage fully visible, historically plausible harness and wheels, strong readable silhouette, isolated with generous margin, no scenery, editorial halftone collage cutout.

A single soft plume of pale leaking gas and smoke rising upward from a narrow source at the bottom center, wispy semi-transparent edges, isolated, no flame, no object, no background, designed as a compositing overlay for animation.

Separated fragments from a shattered Victorian cast-iron gas semaphore signal: small metal panels, lens glass pieces and mechanical fragments arranged with clear space between each piece, isolated, no explosion cloud, no background, designed for individually animated debris.
